observations: Standing fan with three gold-colored blades and a black wire mesh cage.
Two cylindrical lamps are mounted on the sides of the control column.
The control column has a rotary timer dial marked 1 to 6 hours.
Four push buttons are labeled 0, 1, 2, and 3 for speed control.
The brand 'Panasonic' and the text 'The Breeze Communication' are printed on the column in photo 1.
A power cord is visible coiled around the base in photo 0.
The base is a black, square-shaped platform with rounded edges.
Watermarks for 'WARRIBUYANDSELL CONNECT' and 'JIJI' are visible.

claims.evidence: The brand name 'Panasonic' is clearly printed on the neck in photo 1.
Two lamp fixtures are visible on the sides of the neck in photos 0 and 1.
Buttons labeled 1, 2, and 3 are visible on the control panel in photo 1.
A dial labeled '6-hour Timer' with markings 1-6 is visible in photo 1.
There is no video or photo showing the blades in motion or the lamps illuminated.

risks.risk: Motor may be burnt out, seized, or excessively noisy.
risks.proof: A video clip of the fan running through all three speeds.

risks.risk: The twin lamps may have blown bulbs or faulty wiring.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing both lamps switched on and illuminated.

risks.risk: The 6-hour timer mechanism may be stuck or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the timer dial ticking or the fan automatically shutting off.

risks.risk: The oscillation mechanism (head turning) may be broken.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan head oscillating from side to side.

proof_requests: A video of the fan powered on, showing the blades spinning at all speeds and the head oscillating.
A photo of the lamps turned on.
A photo of the manufacturer's technical plate (usually on the back of the motor or under the base) to confirm the specific model number and power ratings.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by brand and features. While functionality is unproven, it can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional/parts) until proof of operation is provided.
